title: PDI factorized conductivity constitutive qualification

candidate.static_K: adaptive log(Kliq(h)) representation of Ksat*((1-OmegaK)*Kcap + OmegaK*Kfilm)
candidate.dynamic_Kvap: authoritative corrected Kelvin vapor term evaluated analytically at runtime using candidate theta, signed h, and current temperature

selection_rule: Choose the loosest static-K limit for which both models pass total-conductivity gates at all preregistered temperatures. If 1e-3 passes, do not test/select 3e-4 as necessary.
factorization_identity_control: With exact theta and exact Kliq, reconstructed Kliq+Kvap must agree with the monolithic corrected source formula to floating-point roundoff.
